description:
On December 10, 2021 Kentucky experienced an outbreak of tornadoes that left the state and surrounding areas in ruin. Brock Mayer and a team of people young and old came together to see what could be done to help the locals in the aftermath of this tragedy. In today's episode, Brock and his friend Gordon share stories of how hope can be found in the midst of calamity.
